related_questions.question: How much can you inherit from your parents without paying taxes?
related_questions.snippet: In California, there is no state-level estate or inheritance tax. If you are a California resident, you do not need to worry about paying an inheritance tax on the money you inherit from a deceased individual. As of 2023, only six states require an inheritance tax on people who inherit money.
